art.subject: Kamchatka Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus examinandus), adult, as seen in Korean woodland during passage in late May-June and September: upperparts olive-green, the crown the same colour; a long yellowish-white supercilium that stops short of the forehead; a dark eye-stripe running right to the bill base; one narrow whitish wing-bar on the greater coverts, sometimes a trace of a second; underparts whitish with a faint yellowish wash and greyish-olive flanks; bill fairly long and strong, dark above with a pale orange-yellow lower mandible tipped dark; dark eye; pale straw to pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: gleaning among leaves in a tree canopy, side view
art.scene: Korean deciduous woodland in late May during spring passage, fresh green foliage; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view gleaning among leaves on a canopy twig: long head with a long whitish supercilium and a broad dark eye-stripe, greyish olive-green upperparts, a single narrow whitish wing-bar, whitish underparts, fairly strong bill with a pale lower mandible tipped dark

adult, side view perched upright on a bare twig: greyish olive-green upperparts, long whitish supercilium, broad dark eye-stripe, single narrow whitish wing-bar on the folded wing, dull whitish underparts with only a faint yellowish tinge, pale lower mandible with a dark tip
art.build: Medium-sized leaf warbler, a little smaller than a sparrow but sturdier than most leaf warblers, with a fairly long, strong bill, a flat crown and long wings. Bill straight and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pale straw to pinkish-brown. At rest the long primaries project well beyond the tertials, and the tail extends a little beyond the wingtips. Active in the canopy, gleaning among leaves. In looks it is practically identical to Arctic Warbler and is told mainly by its call and song.
avoid: Do not paint two bold wing-bars and dark grey legs - that is Two-barred Warbler.
Do not paint a pale central crown stripe (Eastern Crowned Warbler) or a yellow rump (Pallas's Leaf Warbler).
Do not paint bright yellow underparts or a short stubby bill.
